place.source_title: Red ticket kiosk with a gabled roof on the pier promenade (Navy Pier)

brief: A pier kiosk: a red ticket kiosk with a gabled roof on the pier promenade (Navy Pier); a tiny booth with a serving hatch. One photo. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: a red-and-white gabled ticket kiosk on the Navy Pier promenade (c.1995): a tiny booth with a serving hatch and a menu board, in front of moored tour boats; the pier's glass-and-brick halls, striped awnings and patio umbrellas behind

why.note: a booth for each boat line: the smallest commercial unit, rented by the season
